title: Filter the list by priority
action: Add an optional `filter` argument to `list()` in src/todo.mjs. `list({priority})` returns only items with that priority; `list()` with no argument keeps returning every item. An unknown priority throws the same error `add` throws. Write the failing test first, in tests/todo.test.mjs.
acceptance: list({priority:'high'}) returns only the high-priority items
list() with no argument still returns every item, as copies
list({priority:'urgent'}) throws, naming the valid priorities
must_not: change the shape of an item
